reviews.review_description:
Unexpected little game that is a lot of fun.
I’m wheeling and dealing all sorts of valuable items.

Great way to chill in vr.
Great immersion and having a great time surveying my goodies in my shop.

A nice addition to my collection.
I really enjoyed the gameplay and mechanics but could work a bit on the graphics. Really fun, do recommend!

reviews.review_title: Pawn Boss? More Like Pawn Legend!
reviews.review_description:
Who knew running a pawn shop in VR could be so much fun? Pawn Boss is a great little game that has you buying, selling and haggling your way to success. There’s something really satisfying about making a good deal, and even more satisfying when you feel like you’ve got one over on the customer!

It’s a fun, different kind of VR experience that’s easy to get into and keeps you coming back for more. Time flew by for me whilst playing this, its actually quite a lot to this si mulation with market prices to check, ground space to think of, keeping people happy.

Five stars from me – now, who wants to make me an offer I can't refuse?
